tbesh_html:
1) to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament
1a) (Qal) to serve as a necklace
1b) (Hiphil) to make a necklace

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to collar, i.e. adorn with anecklace; figuratively, to fit out with supplies
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to choke; used only as denominative from H6060 (עָנָק),
strongs_1890.kjv_def: compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally.
